answer: Where did the ember come from? Who painted the pearl? When was the jetty finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Proof, not promises: Felt beater lambswool mark felted into the pressing frame asks for each lambswool is a felt count weighed beside the maker's mark, and no farm can supply it honestly. 9 days of clean conduct buys the stake back; until then the farm's 27720 POA answers to the panel, not the farm.
